description.p: ossia score is a sequencer for audio-visual artists, designed to enable the creation of interactive shows, museum installations, intermedia digital artworks, interactive music and more in an intuitive user interface.

ul.li: Sequence OSC, MIDI, DMX, sound, video and more, between multiple software and hardware.
Script and live-code with JavaScript, ISF Shaders, Faust, PureData or C++.
Leverage IoT protocols such as CoAP or MQTT for industrial-grade automation.
Interact with joysticks, Wiimotes, Leapmotions, Web APIs and BLE sensors.
Integrate programs from a wealth of creative programming languages such as Structure Synth, Context-Free Art and Bytebeat.
Load any kind of audio or video format and process visuals through Spout, Syphon, NDI, Shmdata or Sh4lt.
Use VST3, LV2 audio plug-ins and more.

description.p: ossia score 3.9.0 is a large release: highlights are a complete 3D pipeline, new video capture, streaming and tracking devices, advances on custom user interfaces, a more customizable look, along with dozens of new protocols, synthesizers and objects.

ul.li: 3d: a complete 3D scene pipeline. An Asset Loader reads glTF/GLB, FBX, STL, OFF and MagicaVoxel .vox (alongside OBJ and PLY) with their lights, cameras, glTF animations and skins, and FBX node animation. Scene-graph processes filter, tag, group, switch, duplicate and transform a scene, with material overrides driven from the device tree.

3d: new objects include Camera, Camera Array, Camera Switch, Light, Environment, PBR Mesh, Material Override, Transform 3D, Instancer, Text to Mesh, Text to Texture, Cubemap Loader and Composer, Animation Player, and Scene Inspector, with point clouds and gaussian splats supported throughout.
about: the displayed version shows how many commits it is past the release and the branch, for example 3.8.2+42.

ai: librediffusion adds StreamV2V and Flux.2 Klein (with inpainting), multi-step SDXL, img2img-turbo, ControlNet, a runtime LoRA scale, and multi-step CUDA graphs with DMD2, NitroFusion and RIFE presets.

ai: onnx: the pose detector tracks several people, with smoothing, box modes, RTMO, YOLO-pose models and an OpenPose palette. Also new: generic nodes for any ONNX model, Vocos vocoders, separation into stems, MHR body meshes and InstantHMR, SmolVLM, Gemma 3 and more LLMs and VLMs, tokenizers read from tokenizer.json, and WebNN in the web build.
audio: a WASAPI driver through miniaudio, now the default on Windows and following the system's default devices. Thanks @ogauthiersat!
automation: points snap to the timeline's magnetism (the musical grid and the points of nearby processes) while dragged or created; Ctrl disables it.

avnd API: section, table and strip/detail layouts, envelope editors, folder ports, folder-backed or runtime-filled comboboxes (thanks @bltzr!), geometry auxiliary buffers and textures, per-instance semantics, keyed string lists, file and save-path pickers with host-expanded placeholders, xyzw spin boxes, cubemap and render-target texture ports, and tensor ports.

avnd: new objects: Point Tracker (2D and 3D), Beat Tracker, Entity To MIDI, Midi Humanize, Midi Envelope, Regex, Enumerator, Array Best Match, Color display, Control to CV, Switch, Rendezvous, Serialize and Deserialize (JSON, CBOR, text, binary), String tool, Split string, Join strings, String to and from Bytes, Read File, Read File Line, Write File, and the utilities Spigot, Repeat, Mux inlets, Demux outlets, Flip Flop, Bang and Button.
avnd: the LED view has an RGB01 mode, taking colours as floats between 0 and 1.

cables: feedback is now supported in all modes, through delayed connections in the same graph: a cable that closes a loop is made a delayed cable automatically, and graphics feedback cycles render one frame late instead of blanking the output. Only a cable from a node to itself is refused. A cable's type also shows in how it is drawn, and a cable can be dragged from a port's name.
can: new DBC-driven CAN device, browsing the .dbc databases of the library and enumerating the machine's real interfaces.
clap: plug-ins are also searched in CLAP_PATH, and a plug-in that marks its state dirty has it saved.
comment box: an Auto-reflow option wraps the text to the box's width instead of growing it sideways.
custom apps: generated launchers accept --debug (?debug on the web) to show the score editor next to the custom UI, and SCORE_VIDEO_DECODING_METHOD selects the video decoder.
devices: MIDI Controller devices build their tree from a device description, to be able to address knobs and faders directly instead of looking up MIDI CCs.

devices: new depth camera add-on: colour, infrared, depth and point clouds from Orbbec Femto, Gemini and Astra (also over Ethernet), Kinect v1 and v2, Azure Kinect, Intel RealSense and Luxonis OAK cameras, installable as one Depth cameras package from the package manager.
devices: new openzen device: LP-Research LPMS IMUs over serial and USB.
devices: new sysinfo device, exposing the local machine (CPU, GPU, memory, disks, battery, network, open file handles) as an ossia device with a settable refresh rate.
devices: new trackingprotocols add-on: OpenTrackIO, OpenXR, PosiStageNet, RTTrP and TUIO devices.

devices: new videoio add-on: one video input and output device for capture and playout cards, GPU-direct where the card allows it. AJA cards and V4L2 capture on Linux are built in; Blackmagic DeckLink, Magewell and NVIDIA Jetson cameras work when score is built with their respective SDKs. Deltacast, Bluefish444 will be supported later.
devices/processes: processes now have a "Scriptable" mode which makes their parameters accessible through custom addresses in the Local device.
embedded: yocto support with the new meta-ossia repo. Enjoy ossia score as PID1!

fx: new versions of LFO (phase and jitter in degrees, cycles that can lock to the bars), Arpeggiator, Midi quantify, Free metronome, Rate Limiter, ADSR, Flanger, Compressor and Limiter (a lookahead brickwall peak limiter), with times set by the time chooser and able to follow the tempo.
gfx: a script can render an exact number of frames, set the frame-step rate and grab frames to files, for repeatable headless renders.
gfx: a Sink process runs its input at a set rate without displaying it, so a chain whose result is data, such as an AI model's output, is computed.
gfx: cubemap render targets and multiview rendering.

gfx: for capture and SDI rigs: NVIDIA GPUDirect for Video, zero-copy Vulkan capture upload, high-bit-depth planar and packed GPU encoders and a V210 decoder, GPU demosaicing of Bayer sensors, cross-stream frame correlation, bt2020-10 colorimetry, and work towards genlock support.

gfx: new video devices: PipeWire video input and output with zero-copy DMA-BUF, window and screen capture, GStreamer pipelines as input or output (video and audio), and gphoto2 cameras when the library is installed. The FFmpeg device (formerly Libav Output) also reads streams (RTSP, SRT), files, image sequences, cameras and screen capture, records to MP4, MKV, ProRes, DNxHD, AV1, WAV and Opus, and comes with presets.
gfx: shader previews can be toggled at runtime from a new Graphics toolbar.
gfx: window devices expose the cursor position in GL coordinates, next to the scaled and absolute ones.
gfx: with vsync off, a Rate of 0 renders frames back to back as fast as the GPU allows.

js: a much larger API: cables, path lookup, process controls, document metadata, presets carrying a script's program and state, object colours and comments, undo stack and macros, device settings read-back, Score.select(), Score.Editor, a View object for automation and screenshots, and Util.listFiles, listDirectories, openFileDialog, saveFileDialog and removeFile.
js: QML scripts can read and write local files through XMLHttpRequest.

js: Score.Controls, Score.Triggers and Score.Conditions expose a document-wide namespace of controls, triggers and conditions, including those of child processes, also sent to remote control clients; states can address them.
js: Score.Editor gains hasProcessUI, showProcessUI and libraryEntries; createProcess resolves the <LIBRARY>: and <PROJECT>: prefixes; a device's connected() can be called from QML.

js: scripts can build persistent, interactive QML interfaces from native score widgets and Canvas2D painting, with undoable state. Custom UIs can be docked, placed by script, or shown in a window, the side panel or the central view.
library: packages can ship native libraries that load on Linux, macOS and Windows.
midi: new MIDI display process.
osc: COBS framing, alongside the other framings found in the wild.
process: file and folder controls save <PROJECT>: and <LIBRARY>: relative paths, and a Faust import folder is saved relative to the library or the project.
processes: new carto-tcp process, receiving the point clouds that Carto from the Suite SAT streams over TCP.

processes: new cv add-on: computer vision ported from traditional Max/MSP cv.jit, rewritten without OpenCV: GPU filters (threshold, morphology, chroma key, frame difference, optical flow) and analyses (centroid, moments, histogram, corners, Hough lines), and CPU objects for blobs, contours, homography and Kalman filtering.

processes: new lavfi add-on: a process running any FFmpeg filter graph on audio and video, with ports and controls taken from the graph, analyzer metadata as an output, live editing, presets, and filtering kept on the GPU when on the Vulkan backend.
processes: path generator gets its own UI drawing the trajectories and the playing position, more trajectories, and a choice of what its output carries.
processes: puara: Leaky Integrator and Avalanches objects.

project: collect a document's media into its own folder, find missing files with an exhaustive, cancellable search, archive a project to a zip, trim media and remove the files a project no longer uses; a document can declare the platforms it runs on.

protocols: QML protocols gain Bluetooth, NFC and serial bindings, sender information on received UDP messages so replies are possible, automatic deserialization of encodings such as base64, and the OSC type tags a script asks for.
protocols: QML scripts can talk to SocketCAN buses, classic and FD, with Protocols.can(), and list the interfaces with Protocols.canInterfaces() (Linux).
protocols: QML sockets and serial ports gain STX/ETX, 1-, 2- and 4-byte little- and big-endian size prefixes and fixed-length framings, and Protocols.http() takes a full request object.
remote control: an HTTP server, with configurable port, address and path, serving a WebAssembly remote. Thanks @thibaudk!

skin: more complete skinning support, with about thirty bundled skins: editor themes (Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night...), light, greyscale and high-contrast skins, colour-blind-safe skins and skins with beautiful tight pixel fonts. A skin carries its fonts and its widget palette.
sound: the Sound process plays the audio track of video files, and reads AIFC and CAF files.
synths: FoMo, an FM synthesizer, and Kaboom, an electronic drum machine.
synths: granola: polyphonic MIDI grain spawning, velocity-driven grain amplitude, a MIDI listening toggle and an active grain count output.

synths: the Deuterium drum machine becomes a multi-format sampler reading GIG, DLS, SF2, KORG KMP/KSF and plain audio files, with complete sampler control, trigger pads and keyboard, legato, a note-off mode and a MIDI channel filter.
ui: --vector-gui / --no-vector-gui for higher-quality rendering, a configurable base font size, and the Phosphor icon fonts shipped for custom UIs.
ui: a central view stack with a navigation bar per document, and reworked the address bar to be available in every view.
ui: code editors can now be docked or also used as central view.
ui: right-clicking the XY pad opens spin boxes, so a coordinate can be typed or pasted.
ui: scoring internal processes now behaves exactly like scoring device tree parameters, including support for tweening, etc. Simply drag a parameter to a state, etc.
wasm: the LTC, Granola, bendage, Airwindows, cv, ONNX and Deuterium add-ons are available in the web build.

wasm: the web build gets camera input (getUserMedia and WebCodecs), audio input, drag-and-drop media import, asynchronous Load and Save As, documents opened from the page URL, zip project archives, persisted settings and local-storage backups, and the start screen with its online examples.
windows: a Windows arm64 build.
ysfx: a JSFX in the library is described by its own header: description, author, tags and license.
3d: fulldome output offers the four fisheye projections: equidistant, equisolid, stereographic and orthographic.
bendage: the JPEG node uses libjpeg-turbo, about five times faster at 1080p; Airwindows plug-ins get proper parameter widgets.
jk: jk filters understand jq literals, arithmetic, comparisons, //, ? and the builtins, with jq's operator precedence.

ndi: NDI sends every format it can encode from the GPU without a copy. A source is chosen by name and previewed before connecting, with colour, receive format and deinterlacing settings; all eleven receive formats are decoded, including the alpha of UYVA and PA16.
ndi: the newest NDI runtime installed is loaded. It used to mistakenly be the oldest.
ai: onnx models load and run on a worker thread instead of the audio thread, a frame that fails no longer disables the node, and a model that cannot be built does not take the others down.
spat: SpatGRIS, SPAT and ADM-OSC devices take a source index offset.
leapmotion: one Leap Motion device per sensor.
data: large HDF5 and CSV columns are imported as one sampled curve segment.
lsl: LSL outlets are named after their UID.
GBAP: in Voronoi mode a node fades in at the edge of its zone, instead of a sharp jump.
synths: Synthimi and Kabang envelope times are time choosers, and Kabang's UI is redesigned with drum strips.
3d: the Model Display light no longer moves with the transport, and models whose normals face away from the light are lit.
app: --script starts on a document with nothing modal in the way.

app: a redesigned start screen with templates, examples (including those published on the documentation site), project info, archives and an about page listing the license of every bundled component. It covers the main window, returns when the last document closes and is reachable from the Help menu.

audio: a sound file at a different rate than the device, or above 4GB, is streamed instead of decoded entirely into memory, and plays at the right pitch; a document's master volume is applied when it is opened.
audio: the audio engine stays alive across documents, which should reduce errors about audio devices, and a soundcard change while a document is loaded is survived.
audio: the PipeWire back-end adapts to graph quantum and rate changes instead of skipping cycles, and detects a graph that schedules nothing.
automation: resizing an interval with many automations no longer rebuilds every state on each mouse move (0.5 to 1.4 s per move before).
avnd: a Bang or a Button drives any toggle for one tick, and toggles accept numbers.
avnd: an enum control set by name or number from a state or a script takes that value, enum ports start at their declared default, and a name received by message stays a name.
avnd: every built-in object has a functional category and a description, and every port has a name.
avnd: Prompt Composer's keywords are a list, and each weight port follows its keyword when the list is reordered.
avnd: two-, three- and four-component and colour controls carry their unit (cart2D, cart3D, rgb).
dataflow: a single number sent to a vector or colour control is rescaled into the control's range.
devices: the device dialog is sorted, with Video in, Video out and Media categories, and joysticks plugged in while it is open appear.
explorer: large and small numbers are no longer shown in scientific notation.
flatpak: Wayland support.
gfx: ISF event inputs and Faust buttons fire on impulses from cables and messages.
gfx: resizing an output or inserting a node keeps feedback, simulations and persistent passes instead of restarting the graph.
gfx: selecting a shader in the library no longer freezes the GUI for about 200 ms.
gfx: shaders using names that HLSL, MSL or NVIDIA's GL compiler reserve (lerp, frac, new...) are renamed instead of refused.
joystick: game-controller triggers range from 0 to 1.
js: script durations accept flicks, 500ms, 2s, 1min and clock times; --script reads a path as a file and exits non-zero on errors.
library: a shader is credited to its own CREDIT, and a Faust DSP to its declared author.
library: the Add process dialog hides deprecated processes.
library: the out-of-date packages notice moved into the library panel, packages can be filtered by kind, and a failed install keeps the previous version.
linux: the startup check lists the packages to install, checks AVX2 and group membership, and can be dismissed on Wayland.
lv2: when a plug-in has several UIs, score picks an installed one, and refuses UIs built for another Qt version instead of crashing.
mapper: nodes start at zero instead of NaN, follow their sources without echoing values back, and show the script being edited.
media: a camera that cannot be started says so in the Messages panel; on Windows, DirectShow camera formats are named by codec and many more codecs are recognised.
multicursor: a cursor can be grabbed anywhere in its node.

nodal: a node dropped in the view stays where it was dropped without zooming, a node added outside the canvas brings everything into view, a node added to a chain goes next to its neighbour, and a node with only outlets draws them on its right edge.
nodal: a node with hundreds of controls pages through them; folded, it shows only its routing and the controls in use, and folding is saved and undoable. VST and LV2 controls use the control grid.

processes: Value delay takes any value, with feedback, mix, freeze and smoothing; the array combiner gains similarity, distance, arithmetic and comparison modes; the accumulator and counter choose when they send and get an Output bang; Buffer queue gets a manual output mode; Wavecycle glides between frequencies and plays chords; the shell command object takes an interpreter.
bitfocus: Companion modules run as they do in Companion: their saved configuration is kept, shared UDP sockets and binary payloads work, and a crashed module is restarted.
camera: each resolution offers its fastest rate, rather than dozens of slower duplicates.

clap: the song position is sent in the right unit, non-note MIDI and sysex reach plug-ins and come back out, parameter edits from the plug-in are picked up, automation is sample-accurate, and plug-ins share score's audio thread pool.
curve: edition scales to more than 100k points, with sampled segments and waveform rendering; segments can be dragged in the select tool.
custom apps: create-app packages for the web and Windows on ARM64, takes a per-OS environment overlay, and branded apps no longer carry ossia score's icon and branding.
dataflow: binding a control to an address no longer overwrites the control's own unit: a colour or a gain keeps converting correctly.

dataflow: port addresses are picked in an editable combo box that only lists the devices carrying the right kind; the cable drag line follows its port, scrolling continues past the view's edge, and port hit zones are circular.

devices: any device can be exported and imported, the device dialog has a preset view, and device lists have search boxes and follow the keyboard; the Artnet device is renamed DMX (thanks Maude-Antoine), as it also speaks sACN and DMX USB.
explorer: per-type value editors in the tree and in the address panel, with a form for every value type, multi-line strings, and lists and maps edited as lists and maps.
explorer: values of an unfolded node keep updating after a reconnect or refresh, and a device tree is no longer emptied by a failed exploration.
fx, gfx: expressions stop runaway loops instead of hanging the engine.

fx: the Looper's passthrough can be None, Record-only or Always, a change of mode carries on through the loop instead of rewinding, and quantized actions land on bar lines; Pulse to Midi schedules notes causally with minimum and maximum lengths.

gfx: colour pads open the colour dialog on right-click; D3D12 can use shader model 6, its compiler now shipping with the Windows build; shader includes are found in packages installed while score runs.
gfx: full-range video no longer comes out slightly too bright, high-bit-depth video is scaled exactly, and direct video playback applies the output's colour conversion.

gfx: multi-window rendering reworked around one texture feeding all windows, with finer mapping, border lock and off-origin outputs; the window's title is in the device tree, and the mapping grid shows coordinates.
graphics: knobs, sliders, spin boxes, the minimap and the note chooser scroll infinitely using the platform's relative motion APIs instead of a bespoke hack, and behave on multi-screen HiDPI setups.
jit: JIT-compiled add-ons on Windows get C++ exceptions, native TLS and a correct runtime; LLVM 22 and 23 are supported. JIT can finally be considered fully stable, after eight years!

js: a script taken from the library follows the library file instead of a copy frozen into the document, and the inspector offers to update it when the file has changed; scripts edited on disk are picked up.

library: greatly improved scan times, with much more of the scan moved off the main thread; hierarchic preset categories with an optional description; synthesizers have their own category; the package manager says what went wrong when a download fails.
linux: OpenGL prefers EGL over GLX on X11
SCORE_OPENGL_FORMAT=gl|gles picks desktop GL or GLES, and on Wayland rendering no longer stalls waiting for the compositor.
local device: its OSC and WebSocket ports can be set at launch with --local-osc-port and --local-ws-port, and score says when one is already taken. Thanks @bltzr!

lv2, vst, vst3: plug-ins get the real playhead position and also play when the timeline runs backwards; LV2 plug-ins hear transport start and stop, CV ports work as audio, atom ports get the buffer size they ask for, and control values are restored when a document is reopened.
media: more advanced probing reads semi-broken media, such as files with no duration in the header.
midi: device scans also list network MIDI ports, and hardware, software and network ports are grouped the same way on every back-end.
nodal: a cable's end can be dragged to another port, with every selected cable following; a node dropped on a cable is inserted into it; a new cable connects to the first port of a matching type.
nodal: rubber-band box selection and Ctrl+click multi-selection, with the zoom level and canvas position kept across navigation and reload.
piano roll: keyboard-coloured rows, Up and Down transpose the selection (Shift for an octave), and moving notes past the range grows it.
playback: running backwards now reaches MIDI (notes sound in reverse, transport resumes), video (frame-exact seeking, HAP and DXV included) and Faust.

plug-ins: VST, VST3, CLAP and LV2 scans no longer list a plug-in many times over or mark working ones invalid after false time-outs; LV2 is now scanned out of process too, and each format has its own settings.
quantification: quantized starts and metronome clicks land on the right beats: the subdivision grid restarts at every bar line, and positions are right when the timeline runs backwards.
scenario: a multi-selection of processes can be deleted, and Del removes a state message like Backspace.

scenario: a new document lasts eight bars by default (always configurable in the settings), a paste lands where the user is working, nested or not, and a document reopens at the zoom it was saved with.
scenario: a preset dropped on a state creates a box after it, and an Alt-drop of a sound, video, layer, preset or port into empty space makes a box that starts on play.
scenario: dragging inside a process snaps to the time syncs of the sibling processes, and in a child interval's full view the ruler, time signatures and magnetism count from the start of the score.
scenario: states are drawn above their intervals, and a double-click selects the state it creates.
scenario: the state editor uses the device explorer's per-type value editors.

shaders: compute shaders take general geometry, vertices and instances, with multipass at distinct local sizes; ISF gains DIMENSIONS, COPY_FROM, ISF_READ / ISF_WRITE, IMG_* accessors for raw rasters, ISF v1 persistent buffers, name_prev for persistent storage, and a Geometry mode and TRANSPARENCY block for raw rasters; draw counts can come from a GPU buffer.
skin: idle, running and failed intervals are no longer confusable, every skin's contrast is kept within reach of the default, and the last hardcoded colours are gone from the chrome.
sound: tempo-aligned drop-in on running intervals, seeking to where a running copy actually is.
state: a string containing quotes, backslashes or line breaks survives copy and paste and the address dialog.
step sequencer: several sequences, a Duration port, quantized switching, and the playing step is lit; the pattern sequencer gets ports to select the pattern and quantize the switch.

ui: a new knob design, a light on value displays when values arrive, a Pretty toggle on the Value display, a fixed range for Signal display, +/- buttons on integer spin boxes, and Shift to move a vector's components together.
ui: a port's description shows when hovering its label and its control, not only the port.
ui: enumerated device parameters (OSCQuery RANGE.VALS, DMX modes) get a combo box, which accepts typed values not in its list; long combo box lists in the scene scroll.
ui: file and folder pickers open next to the current file, else in the project folder.
ui: fonts are sized in pixels rather than points, so macOS matches everywhere else, and the whole widget UI uses score's font rather than the platform theme's.
ui: hitboxes and interaction areas are larger for core elements, and double-clicking a slider returns it to its default.
ui: selecting and dragging thousands of notes or objects stays fast.
ui: the time chooser is a compact time bar and a knob with a full division table, longer sync durations and a readout cycling free, straight, dotted and triplet; short times get most of the travel.
video: Auto playback picks the renderer from the file's keyframe layout rather than a codec flag and a 1080p cap.
video: direct-mode playback of long-GOP files is about 3x faster (4K H.264 goes from 22 to 72 fps), seeking backwards shows the right frame, and the last B-frames of a file are kept.

video: GPU decoding of DCI X'Y'Z' 12-bit, half-float planar RGB as in EXR files, and the other pixel formats that still went through swscale; raw elementary streams play. We're almost cinema-ready, with a good JPEG2000 decoder we can read DCPs!
video: ProRes and FFV1 no longer go to the Vulkan compute decoders, which got about 2% of every frame wrong.
video: thumbnails are decoded at the height of their slot.
vst3: CC, pitch bend and aftertouch are delivered to the plug-in; the VST3 SDK is updated to 3.8.1.
windows: file names and text with non-ASCII characters work on every build.
ysfx: presets starting with tags are categorized.
granola: granola's trigger rate no longer depends on pitch, the interpolation setting takes effect, and output channels are filled when the source has a different channel count.
deuterium: Hydrogen kits whose instruments share a MIDI note are mapped by instrument order instead of stacking on one key.
kabang: Kabang's pitch envelope applies, a negative Vel->Pitch no longer pins the pitch, and Minibang no longer crashes on a note that arrives before its sample is loaded.
leapmotion: Leap Motion hands are cleared when tracking stops.
GBAP: a GBAP node can be grabbed anywhere on its circle.
synthimi: switching synthimi between poly and mono no longer leaves a stuck note.
bendage: the bendage nodes no longer read or write past their buffers on adversarial images.
airwindows: creating an airwindows process without a plug-in name no longer crashes.
3d: a Splat process gained one extra inlet every time its document was reloaded.
analysis: the stereo pitch and onset objects analysed the left channel for the right one.
app: --help or --version left the next launch in failsafe mode, with OpenGL turned off.
audio: on ALSA, input and output card names were swapped, and a card that cannot record stopped the engine from starting even with no inputs.
automation: two automations of one address meeting at a state recursed until the stack overflowed, crashing the document on load.
avnd: Audio Particles in sync mode triggered at twice the chosen note value, and its position overflowed after about 12 hours.
avnd: event value ports re-read their value at every tick, so Repetition Filter saw repeats.
avnd: impulse buttons were pressed once when an object was created, so a Counter, Accumulator or Buffer queue in manual mode sent at start.
avnd: in objects that also have curve ports, a UI edit could reach the wrong control.
avnd: lists of named float structs arrived as zeros, Array Combiner's Median sorted NaN, and the Device Recorder's Timestamped toggle defaults to on.
avnd: reloading a file or sound file port left dangling data or freed memory on the audio thread, and control outputs nobody reads grew memory without bound.
avnd: the Lightness Sampler read past the image's edge, and the Lightness Computer crashed on Windows.
bitfocus: Companion module processes stop when score quits or is killed.

camera: removing a camera node did not close the device; a camera's compressed mode was ignored on Windows; DirectShow YV12 and YVU9 and V4L2 RGB32 cameras had red and blue swapped; an H.264 DirectShow camera was given the MJPEG decoder.
clap: a CLAP process with no plug-in chosen crashed.
clap: plug-ins without MIDI inputs receive parameter and transport events; event times are rebased and clamped to the tick's buffer span.
core: a second exit request no longer re-enters document teardown; restoring a backup after Save As no longer crashes, and the restored document shows its saved name.
core: plug-ins are torn down in reverse creation order when a document closes, and devices are disconnected before documents are destroyed.

core: quitting crashed when documents were destroyed after the main window, and on NVIDIA Linux drivers when the Vulkan instance was destroyed; a failing background task or a missing library folder aborted the application.
csv: the CSV player and recorder wrote the header twice or crashed on playback.
curve: an automation starting after zero keeps its first segment.
curve: power and easing segments not starting at 0 gave wrong values; the curve tool could stay stuck on the pen; Shift+Alt bends every selected segment.
curve: the crashes and corruptions of curve edition are fixed.
dataflow: a looping process at speed 0 still runs at its place in the loop.
dataflow: chaining after an audio outlet keeps its propagation setting, and removing a cable or undoing restores it.
dataflow: loading a preset now updates curve controls, so the next edit no longer reverts it.
dataflow: sample-accurate value outputs were moved to the start of the tick.
devices: a device refreshed after it disconnected no longer crashes, and cancelling a Learn no longer rebuilds the device and drops its MIDI cables.
devices: opening a document replayed phantom impulses into the explorer, the message recorder and remote control.
effects: resizing the control column left ports hidden and disabled.
engine: --no-gui runs, headless remote play, pause and stop, and --script runs aborted at the end.
execution: a crash lurking in execution cleanup since 2018 is fixed.
execution: play from here in a child interval moves that interval, and an interval played again afterwards starts from its beginning.

execution: pressing play before a large document finished loading crashed; editing a trigger, condition or quantization while a time sync was torn down could crash; closing a document whose triggers watch a destroyed device read freed memory.
execution: the timer that resets a stopped document no longer resets, or crashes on, another document.
execution: triggers and conditions on a missing device no longer hold, and an edit command that throws no longer aborts the application.
explorer: an OSCQuery device showed an empty tree when added; changing a device's camera, joystick or MIDI port kept the old name and broke references; audio gains were not editable in the tree.
expressions: the Expression Value Filter and Micromap used only the first element of x[1] and x[] vectors, and kept the variables of the previous expression.
faust: on Apple Silicon the JIT compiles for the host instead of for Linux.
ffmpeg: audio recorded by the FFmpeg output overran the frame or repeated stale samples.
fx: ADSR jumped back to the sustain level, hid envelopes shorter than a buffer, never settled at zero, and fired on load.
fx: in the Compressor and Limiter, a ratio of 0 divided by zero, and a lookahead of 0 or above 100 ms read the wrong sample.
fx: MathAudioFilter's x/px buffer swap corrupted odd samples.
fx: Midi scale stops every note it starts, and the free metronome ticks every period.
fx: the Envelope RMS was sqrt(sum)/N instead of sqrt(sum/N).
fx: the Limiter squashed everything to about plus or minus 0.02 around a DC offset at its default threshold; it is now a lookahead brickwall peak limiter.
fx: the Looper wrote the wrong span on every tick that did not start at zero, and looped, overdubbed and narrowed its channels out of bounds.
general: many memory leaks and data races found with LeakSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer are fixed.
gfx: a bang on a graphics node fired every frame, and Structure Synth regenerated every frame.
gfx: a colour arriving without its alpha was drawn invisible or black.
gfx: a mirrored vertex Y flipped the winding, so Direct3D culled the wrong faces.
gfx: a preset loaded during playback drew nothing; a .fs and .vs pair dropped together made two processes; compute, geometry-filter and VSA shaders could not be dragged from the library.
gfx: a render target the backend refuses, or a video device created from a script with incomplete settings, aborted the application.
gfx: an exception during a render no longer leaves the frame open for the rest of the session, and a lost Direct3D device is reported by every output.
gfx: an output window could stop drawing when moved to another screen, and a failed graphics backend creation left the output black without a word.
gfx: GPU objects' controls did not convert units and ranges, so an LFO on a Primitive's rotation did not make a full turn.

gfx: ISF shaders sampling a pass target crashed on Vulkan; gl_FragDepth, depth-less targets and six Vertex Shader Art presets failed on Metal; an ISF long input's DEFAULT was read as an index; persistent passes lagged one or two frames behind VVISF; audio FFT and histogram inputs were NaN at sizes that are not a power of two.
gfx: many crashes on document close, device loss and graph mutation during rendering.
gfx: multi-window output was flipped on Vulkan, its soft-edge blend left a bright fringe, cancelling its settings while playing crashed, and a full-screen output on Windows landed at an offset.
gfx: QSG_RHI_BACKEND is no longer set, as it broke VST plug-ins that also use Qt such as Kontakt 8.
gfx: Text node edges were too dark, and an unconfigured Text node was drawn off-screen.
gfx: the Images process did not show its image at start, and crashed when its list shrank during playback.
gfx: Vulkan Video zero-copy decoding works on Windows; an unknown pixel format rendered undefined content.
gfx: window outputs on macOS OpenGL could crash on present.
graph: a cycle of immediate edges is reported instead of silently running nothing.
graphics: an item deleted while it held the mouse grab is deleted later instead of corrupting the grab stack.
gstreamer: little-endian 10-bit 4:4:4 with alpha was decoded as big-endian in the GStreamer, Sh4lt and Shmdata inputs, and caps written without type annotations stayed black.
jit: --compile-node builds again.

js: a QML DeviceEnumerator hung startup on Windows; --script could not run .mjs modules; a GPU script lost its controls on resize, so rect-mapper shapes vanished; a document opened from the command line did not find the library's QML modules.
js: deleting a texture source from QML aborted the application.

js: lists in UI messages did not reach scripts as arrays; Windows file paths bound to QML url properties did not load; Qt.vector2d, vector3d, vector4d, quaternion and matrix4x4 returned empty values; removing a device from a script during playback crashed.
js: MIDI bytes were dropped, audio outlets were never cleared, and four calls aborted the application.
js: QML processes with a UI would only load the second time.
linux: the AppImage segfaulted at startup on hosts with a newer libxcb, and Wayland sessions without XWayland did not start.
media: a camera with no signal no longer hangs its own shutdown; v4l2 cameras reporting a rate range no longer come out at 1 fps.
media: a soundfile control opened the path the document stored rather than the file; drag-and-drop of audio files behind symlinks works.
media: sws_scale read a one-element destination plane array out of bounds.
media: video thumbnails had the wrong aspect ratio and garbage columns, and a mid-stream resolution change read past the frame.
midi: a MIDI input nobody reads grew memory without bound.
midi: a MIDI outlet addressed to a MIDI channel node sent nothing, or sent on the wrong channel.
midi: a missing ALSA sequencer no longer crashes, and the bytes of incoming messages are no longer trusted.
midi: computer keyboard input was broken on X11.
midi: note-offs were dropped for short and adjacent notes; a document naming a MIDI back-end this build lacks no longer aborts.
midi: on ALSA raw, opening an output port already in use hung instead of failing.
midi: on Windows (MME), Start, Stop, Continue, Tune Request and Reset messages were dropped, and closing an input could corrupt the heap.
midi: PipeWire MIDI ports could crash when created before being opened, and could not be reopened.
midi: the computer keyboard could produce notes above 127; in Patternist, HC is the hi conga (note 66).
model display: the projections read textures upside down on Vulkan, and an untextured mesh was not drawn white.
osc: an address first learned as a bang stayed a bang; an OSC receiver on port 0 crashed when stopped on macOS.
patternist: held notes are released when stopping, note-offs reach the output, and every step a tick covers is played.
pd: a Pd process with no patch read out of bounds.
piano roll: undoing a resize of notes did not redraw them.
process: a time chooser's declared default was read as quarter notes instead of seconds.
process: an unknown uuid no longer loses the process and its cables.
process: file chooser ports lost their file-type filter when a document was reopened.
process: rebuilding a drifted process's ports dropped every control value; saved ports are matched by name when a process changed.

protocols: in QML protocol scripts, line framing dropped all but the first line of a read, a remote close and onFail were ignored, inboundWS did not listen, the HTTP client dropped query strings, WebSocket callbacks ran off-thread, and Device.addNode and removeNode corrupted memory or left stale addresses.
protocols: removing a network device during a pending read used freed memory; the WebSocket device's host is filled from its script again; mapper devices no longer crash at teardown.
recording: playback started while a recording waits starts the recording.
scenario: dragging a brace snapped a duration as if it were a date.
scenario: going back from the nodal view kept a partial zoom, and the play bar could crash after entering and leaving a sub-interval while playing.
scenario: in an interval with a tempo but no time signature, Patternist and sound files followed different clocks.
scenario: jumping back while playing left finished intervals marked as ended, so they stopped as soon as they started.
scenario: pasting multiple processes into a scenario crashed or silently failed.
scenario: processes added while an interval is already executing are started, and process order survives a save and load round-trip.
scenario: resizing a playing interval reaches the engine.
scenario: the Shift lock and Ctrl scale modes could stay on after the key was released over another widget.
sdk: the published Windows and macOS SDKs, and run-time add-ons, can build and load add-ons again.
serial: a line delimiter longer than seven characters corrupted memory.
sound: an interval starting or ending in the middle of an audio buffer overwrote the next interval's samples and drifted; off-grid starts left a one-sample gap.
sound: changing the tempo during raw playback made the read position jump and click; the repitch mode padded small buffers with silence.
sound: dragging a sound before the start of the timeline crashed, and looping from a negative position read out of bounds.
sound: full-scale samples wrapped to the opposite polarity at 24 and 32 bits.
sound: RubberBand's start delay is trimmed, so stretched sounds are not late.
sound: seeking in a file decoded through FFmpeg went back to the start of the file.
sound: the waveform could stay blank after zooming or panning.
spout, syphon: Spout follows GL sender changes and registers D3D senders correctly; a Syphon texture survives its sender quitting.
startscreen: HiDPI rendering and cursor behaviour on Wayland.
startscreen: the initial network request could hang it on misconfigured Windows machines.
step sequencer: synced steps count from the start of the process; a pattern with a rejected lane no longer loses its length.
syphon: an input on Metal with no server advertised built the OpenGL decoder and dropped every draw.
ui: Value display dropped values when its log was longer than 1; on X11 HiDPI or with UI zoom the cursor was drawn offset from the pointer.
video: closing or seeking an image sequence no longer crashes.
video: playback of decoders without pkt_dts and of thread-sliced codecs in direct mode.
video: truncated files and files without a duration no longer spin or abort, and formats libswscale cannot handle are refused.
vst, vst3, clap, ysfx: MIDI landing in a tick shorter than one sample is sent with the next block.
vst: a document whose VST is not installed no longer segfaults when its UI is built.
vst: plug-in libraries are no longer unloaded, since many crash when unloaded.
wasm: gfx output windows recover from permanent black after hide and show, and no longer steal the keyboard.
wasm: OSC devices can be created, gamepads deliver values, and Web MIDI inputs no longer abort when closed and have correct timestamps.
widgets: range sliders did not drag unless their domain was 0 to 1; a momentary button press is one undo step; a second click on a file control opened a second dialog.
windows: an absolute path became a UNC share path.
ysfx: copy-paste and undo/redo are fixed.
ysfx: the tick offset was ignored, so a tick starting mid-buffer read and wrote at the wrong position.
Documents are saved in format 5: score 3.9 says when a document comes from a newer version, but 3.8 cannot open documents saved by 3.9.
macOS 13 or later is required.
Kabang and Minibang moved from the built-in objects to the synthimi add-on.
The Libav Output device is now the FFmpeg device, and the Artnet device is now named DMX.
ADSR, Flanger, Compressor and Limiter have new versions; the old ones are renamed "... (old)", hidden from the library, and still load in existing documents.

description.p: ossia score 3.8.2 is a minor hotfix release.

ul.li: gfx: hdr: support for HLG format and ICtCp-encoded videos. Better support for Display P3 and BT.2100
gfx: fix a double-uninit issue that could lead to crashes with some objects.
render pipeline: initialize blend modes to One instead of Zero in the raster pipeline renderer.

description.p: ossia score 3.8.1 brings major video and multi-window improvements, full backwards playback, and many bug fixes.

ul.li: video: massive hardware decoding rework with D3D12 and Vulkan Video backends, thanks to FFMPEG.
video: added automatic mode to pick the best hardware decoder for a given task.
video: HDR support for Window output (tested on macOS and Windows).
video: HDR shaders added to user library: tonemapping, exposure, OETF, etc.
video: rework of color processing, proper support for full range MPEG, fix Cineform support
video: hardware-decoded DXV
video: finish the implementation for GPU-accelerated rendering of every YUV format in existence
video: add a direct synchronous playback option for formats that support it (HAP and other all-I formats)
video: add .ts as acceptable extension
video: add a multi-window output mode to handle multi-projector mapping, with soft-edge blending and warping.
scenario: allow backwards playback
time ruler: implement scrubbing by double-clicking and dragging
process: add a VU meter object for audio visualization
process: add a video mapper (rect-mapper) object in the user library for mapping multiple textures in one viewport.
process: add an advanced-text object in the user library for fancy text rendering.
process: add a presentation object in the user library because what use is a graphics software which isn't even able to render slides.
isf: initial infrastructure for cubemap textures
network: add a debug log panel to HTTP, WebSocket, etc.
js: add Util.environmentVariable(), Util.timestamp(), file info utility functions
js: add API functions for working with TimeVal
js: add a positionChanged signal for UIs ; implement Score.scrub(milliseconds)
js: store a path to allow processes that have local file dependencies to retrieve them ; enables creating advanced QML objects with multiple files.
js: give access to Util in JSProcessModel
cli: js: allow to run a script on startup with --script
gfx: add infrastructure to allow objects to fetch a texture from a previous node instead of being rendered into
ui: allow to disable the UI updates during execution for low power systems
core: add SCORE_PRETTIFY_JSON=1 environment variable to save JSON indented
tools: add a git update tool
ui: improve styling for Qt Quick objects
ui: make it easier to start a drag from a port which already has a cable
ui: make port labels clickable
video: improve thumbnail computations and seeking logic
video: better heuristics for direct video playback
video: use software decoding as far as possible for thumbnails
js: use Basic style for QML UIs to match score style
js: force update of items on each tick to ensure View3D updates correctly
create-app: include assets from score file directory in create-app scripts for all platforms. Thanks @ogauthiersat!
3rdparty: broad library update
ci: update to SDK 36 (FFmpeg 8.1)
msvc: update to VS2026
ui: fix that library download check had been moved to opening the settings UI
ui: fix wrong condition to check whether value input is some binary string
ui: fix scroll in timeline view scrolling the interior of nodal views
metal/d3d: fix background texture inverted. Fixes #1968
exec: fix looping when playing backwards
scenario: drop on cable: fix crash when a node would be changed in a separate slot upon drag and drop
video: fix IgnoreTempo property read missing regression. Thanks @ogauthiersat!
video decoder: add a missing flush
lfo: fix phase in quantified mode
lfo: fix phase missing a multiplication by pi
js: fix state not restoring on graph change
js: fix using background textures from QML in hidden views
js: fix a QtQuick3D deletion order issue
js: fix passing paths that have LIBRARY: or PROJECT: prefixes
js: GPU node fixes for state handling
qml: put the ASIO state in a separate thread-safe object to prevent concurrency issues in mapper device
qml: set simpler environment for Python support
coremidi: fix observer not being initialized
core: fix settings crash on close
core: make the settings children of qApp so that JS engine does not appropriate them
ports: fix changing between ControlInlet and ValueInlet at runtime for e.g. JS script
avnd: variable ports: fix missing resize of intermediary buffers
avnd: increase resiliency against 0 I/O channels ; fix order of calls for channel allocation
avnd: fix that buffers were only up to 31 bit size, instead of 32. 4GB buffers are now possible if the GPU handles it.
gfx: prevent a node that has been just removed to be added again as a preview node
gfx: null check fix in buffer release
preview: fix gamma blending
model display: fix that preview had broken
fft: kfr: fix an issue with deallocation
linux: fix missing avahi-daemon program warning on some distros. Thanks @ogauthiersat!
tools: fix missing line feed in mac custom app launcher environment. Thanks @ogauthiersat!
core: prevent dummy warning with Clang 22 on each __COUNTER__

description.p: ossia score 3.8.0 is a major release bringing many new features and improvements.

ul.li: arpeggiator: add more controls, add a random mode
array tool: add a way to insert and erase values in the input array at a regular stride
ci: add a manual workflow to enable triggering builds with custom CMake options
code editor: add built-insearch with Ctrl+F
console: implement completion, persistent history and readline-like shortcuts
core: add utility functions to detect MDM enrollment
core: allow loading addons that have runtime dependencies in Documents/ossia/score/support/
core: change process priority on startup on win32
cuda: add utility function to check whether it is available
custom ui: add support for QtWebView if available (needs a source build, we won't ship QtWebEngine as it requires a MSVC Qt build)
custom ui: allow to override appname/domain/etc with env vars to simplify custom apps

custom ui: greatly improve the capabilities for creating custom apps on top of ossia score: support QRC files, icons, etc. Add helper scripts and templates to allow people to create their own custom ossia score-based apps.
custom ui: improve fonts and color palette
device recorder: allow to set separator in generated CSV file
devices: add support for QML protocols which require OAuth authentication with Ossia.OAuth (currently requires building from source with QtNetworkAuth support).
devices: enable adding some devices during execution (Camera, Window, etc.).
devices: implement a new Default Device kind for cameras, MIDI devices and gamepads, that will select the default device on the user's system. Useful for examples, etc.
exprtk: add useful math functions: bitwise_and, bitwise_or, bitwise_xor, bitwise_not, bitwise_shiftl, bitwise_shiftr, map, norm, step, lerp, smoothstep, smoothstep5
ffmpeg: handle gpu decoding of 16-bit float single-channel textures

geometry: Add a raw Raster Pipeline object which allows to render using entirely custom shader, with only a small veneer of isf. e.g. this allows to define what are the vertex inputs / outputs with much greater control than classic ISF shaders. This also allow instanced rendering.
geometry: Rework geometry in depth, allow geometry and buffer passing in every avnd objects, add support for instancing.
geometry: allow to have both CPU and GPU buffer handles, automatically convert in-between depending on the needs of objects.
gfx: add support for Spout in the D3D11, D3D12 and Vulkan backends.
gfx: add support for Syphon in the Metal backend.
gfx: allow buffer ports to pass buffers around. White ports can now carry either buffers or textures.
gfx: compute shader: render single-component textures as white instead of red.
gfx: implement support of SSBOs as output of Compute Shader process
icons: add icons for console_on/console_off in icons_16. Thanks @aklevy!
images: add support for more image formats, including SVG.
js: Add new API for storing and retrieving state of JS objects across restarts and communicating between UI and execution.
js: Fully implement custom UI support.
js: Make sure that engines respect import paths, and change presets to use a qmldir to import JS files, so that we do not hit QTBUG-107204
js: Whenever possible, load QML files from disk to trigger the disk cache, which will enable much faster loading / reloading on the execution thread
js: add Device.toValue function, to convert JS values to a simpler representation
js: add Util.uuid()
js: add a System object to retrieve general system info
js: add support for Qt Quick 3D to create 3D UIs easily as well as give access to PBR materials, environment maps, etc.
js: add support for downloading packages from the Library.* api
js: allow to have both an execution script and a UI script.
js: give access to transport object, to connect to play(), stop(), etc.
js: gpu: allow using texture inlets
js: major rework: Have a single engine per-thread with distinct QQmlContext instead of one engine per object
js: more utility functions
js: new APIs (Library, System, etc)

js: new api functions: Score.device("foo"); Score.device("Window").window(); Score.save() / Score.load() / Score.saveAs(); Score.documentPlugin(), mainly useful to enable saving custom data from JS into a score.
layouts: add new layouts displaying all ports vertically when an object is in folded mode.
led view: add ability to set an explicit size
library: Add a new Timing category for all the timing-related objects (metronome, MIDI Sync, LTC, etc.)
lightness computer: add support for custom swizzle to handle uncommon LED formats.
mapper: allow to create dummy nodes just to store and retrieve data
midi: add MIDI sync objects to generate and track MIDI Clock and Timecode.
midi: add support for interpreting and / or sending Note ON with a value of 0 instead of note off. Needed for instance for some Novation Launchpad devices.
midi: handle reloading a midi device across backends / OS through various heuristics

new process: Add many geometry utilities: Geometry Info to get basic info about an input geometry, Extract attribute / buffer / etc., Create a mesh from multiple buffers, Pointcloud to mesh, Repack attributes to pack or multiple attributes of a geometry into a single buffer.
new process: Array to Buffer and Buffer to Array, to go easily e.g. from an OSC message to a GPU buffer.
new process: LTC input.

new process: Tempo synchronizer. This process will analyze incoming position and speed variations, obtained for instance from timecode, and turn them into real-time speed adjustments to keep smooth playback.
new process: add a ArrayToTexture object
new process: add a multi-choice object
new process: add a node text box to leave comments around
new process: add a queue object
new process: add a value mixer object
new process: add an audio splitter
new process: add utilities for vec2f/3i/etc.
new process: introduce StreamDiffusion support (real-time inference of GenAI image workflows), ported to C++ from StreamDiffusion Python code for absolute maximum performance. Requires CUDA.
new process: add an XWax-based DVS processor to control timelines with scratching. Thanks @mbncr for the testing.
node item: many improvements: display titles for all ports, enforce port names on construction
package manager: allow to download packages without main ui
ports: ports without a UI control will now display a label.
processes: allow processes to have both a script editor and a custom UI by separating the concept of script-editable process.
processes: allow to match multiple address groups in objects that can send / receive from/to multiple addresses
qml/gfx: handle QSG_RHI_BACKEND. If set, it will override the chosen graphics backend.
scenario: add zoom with scroll wheel, fix zoom +/- centering
script editor: style update. Default font is now IBM Plex which is much more readable on Win32
scrub: implement scrubbing on scenario
sound: implement backwards audio playback ; Also add a limit on how low we can downsample as it seems that libsamplerate does not like very small tempos
time ruler: double click becomes play from here
ui: add a way for nodes to not have a background
ui: add many new built-in fonts and update existing ones to last versions.
ui: allow replacing a cable by dropping a new cable on an existing one
ui: allow to set visual outputs as background
ui: basic scrub with play tool
ui: refactor more deeply script processes to allow processes to have separate scripting and UI.
ui: support text OSC messages with line breaks and tabs
ui: when dropping a video input device, create a passthrough
utils: allow to replace %n in filenames in recorder processes by the current number
widgets: add a folder chooser
widgets: allow to drop library elements on top of file chooser widgets
windows: enable gcodeview by default so that we can debug again
windows: handle more video pixel format
window device: add fps tracking
ysfx: allow to use saike version, change official builds to use it
ysfx: major improvements: support resizing, support menu, support cursor API
ysfx: support livecoding of YSFX plugins
avnd: add support for more cases of texture inputs
avnd: allow nodes to upload buffers to gpu directly
avnd: allow to set line edit width
avnd: minor improvement to mouse events
avnd: work on updating texture sizes dynamically
bitfocus: handle number fields without range
bitfocus: implement some missing features
ci: add the possibility to pass a custom cache file when triggering a workflow
ci: boost 1.90, updates to every thirdparty library.

core: add a much more precise timer implementation than Qt timerEvent. We go from roughly 5 ms of variation to less than 0.5 ms, which gives much more stable FPS for outputs such as with Spout, NDI, etc.
core: improvements to floating-point environment handling to make sure we always are in a sane state.
core: load app settings if using --ui mode
core: rework InterfaceList to reduce build times
csv recorder: better handle escaping when writing
custom mesh: make it more tolerant of objects that havent finished building their geometry yet
exec: more thread enforcement, move some things from audio thread to main thread
execution: put all the initial cable creation into one single transaction
execution: revert to spsc for execution queue, now with better threading guarantees
expr: sin instead of cos for math generator
flatpak: many fixes and upgrades to all the libraries. Update to 6.10 runtime and clang-21.
freetype: rendering improvements
geometry filter: put it in the gpu thread
gfx: compute shader: limit buffer size to theoretical max for float[] as Qt RHI API supports 32-bit buffer sizes max (e.g. 2GB max per buffer).
gl: Force nvidia offload on linux only if there is any non nvidia gpu
gui: increase default ui update fps for VST, etc.
hidpi: fix artefacts when dragging nodes around
hidpi: improve rendering on non-integer ratios
isf: add some logic to handle parameters with default value but not min or max
js: improve default js script
js_utilities: implement more type conversions Qt between ossia
libraries: support FFMPEG 8
libraries: update HDF5
library: rework categories ; fix missing sorting on subcategories
lv2: implement full midi 1 between 2 conversion to enable more plugins to work
mqtt: upgrade to boost.mqtt5 when available
process: improve inspector label
sh4lt: update to sh4lt 0.2.0. Thanks @nicobou!
spline: improve the positioning of the origin axes
spout: direct gpu input instead of cpu copy
spout: improve frame sync
spout: update library to latest version
syphon: update library to latest version
addons: fix off-by-one error which prevented addon loading bar to reset
appimage: fix that appimage recipe did not account for the new libv4lconvert not matched by libv4l2*
audio recorder: fix that the filename was not being sent anymore
audio: fix audio device document reload not recreating custom nodes
buffers: successful processing and passing around of gpu buffers
c++: just disable modules altogether, clang-scan-deps is broken on too many platforms
ci: add missing Qt SVG where needed
ci: do not fail macOS if there are no certificates
ci: fix longpath support on git clone on windows
ci: macos: fix frameworks that do not have headers
ci: simplify osx signing script
ci: update to sdk35 for switch to ysfx from @JoepVanlier
ci: wrong package name for fedora
command: add missing CreateTimeSync_Event_State in the CreationMetaCommand. Thanks @thibaudk!
command: fix #1879. Thanks @thibaudk!
core: fix live-coding order of operations issues
csf: handle differing input formats for input image
devices: fix a disconnect order bug
drive-by: fix vsts crashing if reloading on a computer that does not have said vst
gfx: rework of the general timer and vsync mechanism
gpu: large refactor and simplification of the gpu nodes
images node: fix infinite loop when setting an OSC address with non-null images
images: fix import of paths from library, fix scaling changing when preview was selected
inspector: add missing script process button
isf: fix events
jit: fix for clang-21 api changes
js: ensure the QJSValueList is destroyed in the same thread than the QQmlEngine
js: fix dynamic TextureSource objects
js: force clear color in TextureSource if we are not connected, to avoid artifacts
js: gpu node: always recreate it on script change for now
js: handle Qt versions that do not have QQuickRhiItem
layout: fix a crash when pasting string in a lineedit
lfo: fix pixmap sizes in hidpi
library: SCORE_ADDITIONAL_SCRIPT_INCLUDE_PATHS now supported on windows
library: skip .ui.qml files
library: use org name / app name for default path instead of hardcoded ossia/score
linux: fix appimage platform scripts
lv2: fix duplicate paths which can cause issues when opening UIs
macos: fix font bug due to QTBUG-143506
mapper: add debounce on the roots computation so that we only ever use the last version
metadata commands: handle cases where objects cannot be reloaded
msvc: support building with clang-cl
node item: prefer name to label
opengl: only check once for the GL capabilities
pipewire: handle cases where pw gives us more frames than requested
plugins: add missing composer key plug-in. fixes #1899
port source / port sink: also accept an inlet / outlet pointer directly
portaudio, samplerate: update to version that support cmake greater 3.5
presets: fix that values sometimes did not reload
process: make sure that processes do not lose their icons in object item model
qml: handle disconnection / reconnection of devices
qt: minor fix to hash combine
scenario: fix skin editor. Thanks @sophiepartoffranceinscotland for the report!
scenario: fix that timebar was disappearing when jumping into a subscenario that did not have it
serial: fix sending of OSC messages as bundles through Serial object
structure synth: ignore empty requests to prevent redundant work
thread pool: increase default priority
thread: add finer-grained functions to detect current thread
time_value: fix a logic error in addition.
timers: set timerId to -1 when unset
tools: fix developer.sh referencing an old, deleted function. Fixes #1909
tools: update fetch-sdk.sh to use proper macOS archive name
ui: add missing help tooltip to some items
ui: allow to force native dialogs
ui: do not try to restore
ui: enforce double precision for spinbox range computation, fixes a graphical bug with undo and reloading
ui: fix parsing of [] as ["[]"] and "" as [""] for list addresses
ui: fix small issues with folder chooser
ui: fix that time node look ugly when devicepixelratio between 1.5 and 2.
ui: fix title missing update when save as
ui: greatly improve performance of redraw of musical bars
ui: improve useability of some UI widgets from JS ; add support for vulkan backend for QtQuick in JS
ui: improvements to widget processes ; add a false-y check to impulse
ui: minor hidpi adjustments
ui: send interval updates even in --no-gui
video: make more robust in the face of invalid video files
vst3: skip hidden params
vst: adjust name / label
vst: fix that we have to do additional checks before unloading modules on mac
widgets: fix wrong relayout calculations when the size of a child widget changes
widgets: improve ComboBox mapping from avnd objects
win32: add enumerateCameraDevices implementation
win32: add vulkan sdk to github actions
win32: always ship libwinpthread, and ship a recent version
win32: fix loss of focus in library
win32: fix support of cameras that only report one FPS
win32: improve debug support
window: fixes under linux for updating refresh rate dynamically

description.p: ossia score 3.7.1 is a minor patch release on top of the large 3.7 version from two days ago, mainly to fix the build against newly-released clang-21.

ul.li: Fix build on clang-21, necessary for MSYS2 packages.
Fix that Wavecycle process had been inadvertently removed.
Minor graphics pipeline improvements.
Fix an issue with the drop of preset in hotswap mode.
Math expressions: fix that pos was not always set to the correct value.

description.p: ossia score 3.7.0 is a feature-packed back-to-school release, with a specific focus on deep bugfix, as well as UX and quality-of-life improvements.

ul.li: AirWindows: mono plug-ins will now be able to be used in polyphonic contexts (e.g. they will be scaled to the number of input channels.
Array recombiner: add a transposition mode to turn for instance [ r, g, b, r, g, b ] into [ [ r r ] [ g g ] [ b b ] ].
Audio: initial ADM-OSC support in the Spatialization device.
Beat metronome: it now has inlets for every subdivision, and keeps track of the count.
Execution: annotate the code base to ensure that execution things happen in the correct thread.
GPU: allow the ossia::geometry class to carry GPU handles in addition of CPU buffers.
Interpolator: make the alpha factor minimum lower to enable very, very smooth operation.
JS: add a Score.createCable(outlet, inlet) function.
JS: add a Utils.writeFile function.
JS: allow to add additional script include paths through SCORE_ADDITIONAL_SCRIPT_INCLUDE_PATHS environment variable.
JS: allow to create processes by UUID.
JS: allow to introspect all the processes in the library.
JS: allow to use Qt.exit(0).
Library: allow to scan QML objects with imports that do not have versions (Qt 6 QML).
Local tree: add a /script address that allows running JS console scripts.
Local tree: if sending the OSC message /exit force then no dialog will be shown to ask the user to save modified scores. This will cause data loss if not careful!
Local tree: properly support processes with variable numbers of ports.
New process: Accumulator. Statistical tools on incoming values: outputs sum, count, mean, variance, median, kurtosis, min and max.
New process: Array to texture. Turn a [ R G B A R G B A R G B A ] input array into a video texture.

New process: Compute Shader. This allows to use compute shader to generate and process images. This is one of the last steps towards a useful GPU-based instancing node for massive particles rendering.
New process: Counter. Counts the incoming messages. Can optionally loop over a provided max or clip when the max is reached.
New process: Easetanbul. Delicately ease from one incoming value to another with the classic easing functions.
New process: Pulse view. A simple LED that lights up on incoming messages.
New process: Repetition Filter. A simple object to filter repeated values, useful for quick debounce.

New process: Value Filter. A full-blown toolkit to filter incoming values according to multiple criterion: combines noise gate, range filter, repetition filter with a deadzone, hysteresis, clipping, and temporal filter.

New process: Vertex Shader Art. This allows to create dynamic audio-reactive visuals from vertex shaders, based on the eponymous website. Be sure to update the user library to get the new shaders, imported from the website github!
New processes: Bendage, a set of video-bending processes for real-time image destruction: JPeg, Xlippy and Safe Word. They had been developed years ago but sadly forgotten... More to come!
New protocol: LSL (Lab Streaming Layer) for integration with scientific hardware and software.
Object Loader: will now display .ply files in addition of .obj.
QML: add an OSC packet processor to easily handle OSC packets in custom protocols.
QML: add support for setting QVector2D / 3D / 4D values.
Shaders: shaders with a mouse input will now automatically start mapped to the first Window devices mouse.
Sound: clicking on the waveform will now select it.
UX: add a shift+delete shortcut to remove a process in the middle of a chain while keeping the connections in the chain alive if the processes before and after are compatible.
UX: allow to create nodes while dropping into an empty full view.

UX: allow to drop a process or preset from the library onto a cable to insert it in the middle of a chain, if the first inputs and outputs are compatible. Drop will be indicated by the cable becoming dashed.

UX: allow to drop a process or preset from the library onto a node to insert it in the middle of a chain, if the first inputs and outputs are compatible. Drop will be indicated by the node border becoming orange. This allows hot-swap behaviour, to easily switch for instance a shader or an audio effect for another live.
UX: change the visualization of ports when they contain an address, to indicate better whether the address is active or not.
UX: dropping multiple processes or files in nodal view will now properly offset them by a few pixels to improve clarity.
Value display: it is now possible to request the process to log the last N received messages.
Video: clicking on the thumbnail will now select it.
Algorithms: replace std:: implementations by custom ones to improve speed under ASAN.
Audio: thorough rework of audio start / stop ; fix the annoying JACK warning when opening a new document.
Avnd: add an automated RGBA from / to RGB conversion for processes that want to operate on CPU RGB textures.
Avnd: improve the color handling API to allow more precise skinning of processes.
Avnd: various small backend improvements especially for handling musical ticks.
CI: force ffmpeg@7 on macOS homebrew as ffmpeg@8 does not export symbols?
CI: ton of bugfixes and change tracking as usual.
CLAP: implement more features of the spec, in particular tempo / time signature support.
CLAP: make flush occur in the exec thread, not the main thread, per the spec.
Execution: fix a long-lived execution bug where setting the speed too fast could cause an invalid token request to be submitted to processes.
Execution: many smaller improvements and optimizations.
FFT: multiple fixes to FFT implementation.
GPU: various improvements and bug fixes to the render loop.
ISF and other shaders: fix that the default shader had disappeared, when dropping the process without an existing preset.
ISF: many backend improvements and simplifications. Deep rework of audio textures handling.
ISF: remove now-unneeded values from UBOs.
Library: ensure subcategories are sorted.
Library: performance optimizations.
Local tree: bugfixes.
Metronome: fix a potential division by zero.
Network: handle cases where socket shutdown throws an exception.
Nodes: improve default node sizing and allow smaller nodes.
ONNX: add a SCORE_ONNX_FORCE_PROVIDER env var to allow setting the ONNX provider manually.
ONNX: many bugfixes to various models implementations.
Sound: do not resize the main interval if dropping a sound file. This fixes a bug where dropping a sound in an empty node could have stopped playback due to the sound having a finite duration.
Sound: fix that sound would sometimes disappear when changing the used soundfile live.
Sound: fix that trying to load invalid audio files could lead to unhandled exceptions.
Sound: update drwav to latest version which allows to handle more cases of ACID tags.
Spline: fix that it did not loop.
Time chooser widget: improvements to range handling.
Tooling: various bugfixes and improvements to fetch-sdk.sh.
UI: cosmetic adjustments to prevent process to sometimes leak by 1 pixel in the background.
UI: do not show the PROJECT / LIBRARY paths in Button UI.
UI: fix that the first switch between nodal and temporal mode could lead to a wrong zoom value being saved.
UI: improve render performance in execution due to the little green bar constantly causing a repaint of the cables.
UI: prevent cables seemingly plugging into nothing when objects are connected in the same interval. They will now be turned into short dashed stubs pointing to the direction of the other part.
UI: prevent long labels from overflowing in nodes.
UI: various fixes caused by cases where the mouse release event would not be delivered to graphical items, leading the score to possibly end up in an incoherent state.
UI: various fixes to drag and drop getting stuck
UX: fix that nodes for sound and video did not always have the correct size when switching to nodal view.
VST/VST3: fix a crash that occured when dropping a port in a parent interval.
VST/VST3: scanner will now also look in .vst / .vst3 in the HOME folder in all platforms.
Video: playback bugfixes.

description.p: ossia score 3.6.1 is a small series of bugfix on top of 3.6.0. Special SIGGRAPH2025 edition!

ul.li: Audio: Integrate the great Airwindows audio plug-ins.
Primitives: plane can now have varying number of subdivisions.
JS API: add a function to allow getting the current save file.
Model display: add support for controlling blending options to enable better particle effects.
Geometry filter: add support for reading .glsl files from the library directly. Check the new examples!
Core: fix an execution bug due to concurrency and threading in GPU threads.

description.p: ossia score 3.6.0 is a major release introducing useful new features and objects.

ul.li: AI: new model support: FastVLM for video-to-text real-time inference.
AI: new model support: GAN image generation e.g. with MobileStyleGAN, FBAnimeGAN. More to come!
AI: new model support: GAN image processing e.g. with AnimeGANv3, DeblurGAN, FSRGan. More to come!
AI: new model support: LLM inference with Qwen3.
Audio: add initial support for CLAP plug-ins on Mac, Windows and Linux. Testing and feedback needed!
Audio: new reverber inspired from vintage Alesis MIDIVerb (BarrVerb, ported from github.com/ErroneousBosh/BarrVerb).
Avnd: improvements to the available APIs for UI to enable more use-cases with cross-controls interactions.
Bytebeat: implement a safe mode to try and avoid SIGFPE errors when a division by zero happens due to wrong bytebeat code.
Core: add xtensor, xsimd and xtl and eigen as official built-in libraries accessible to score addons.
Core: AI prompt composer.
Core: AI prompt tweener.
Core: the codebase now officially requires C++23 to build.
EGLFS / vkkhrdisplay: allow to exit the app with esc when running without X11 or Wayland for unattended installations.
Gfx: add support for Shadertoy effects, by drag'n'drop of Shadertoy URLs into a score which will trigger an automated conversion to ISF.
JIT: port to jitlink which fixes a lot of limitations when JIT-compiling plug-ins.
Linux: add a --platform argument to the appimage, to replicate the functionality of the previous Raspberry Pi scripts (ossia-score-eglfs, etc).
LV2: fixes for finding plug-ins in /usr/ with the AppImage.
Patterns: add support for patterns from drumpatterns.onether.com.
Processes: new data processing tool: Classifier (based on RapidLib, similar to Wekinator).
Processes: new data processing tool: Regressor (based on RapidLib, similar to Wekinator).
Processes: new object: interpolator. From a set of weights and a set of values, provides the linear interpolation of each values. Useful for navigating latent spaces!
Processes: new object: Nodes, to allow interpolation across multiple states. Features both a "circular node" mode, as well as a Voronoi mode.
Processes: new objects in the Puara toolkit: Correlation, Compass, Binarize, ERP, Clustering, PCA, Power Band. Thanks @pyandcpp-coder!
Processes: new objects: Impulse, String, Float, Integer to force the casting of a value type.
Processes: new objects: Knob, Multislider to have simple UI affordances to control parameters.
QML UI: add a TextureSource object to allow custom UI to import a texture from the output of a process.
QML UI: Qt Quick and Qt Quick Controls are now available to use for external UIs with official releases, which allows to make custom software with advanced UIs backed by a given score.
Script console, mapper device: add objects to allow low-level access to TCP and UDP sockets (#1798) as well as OSC.
Script editor: syntax highlighting for Faust code.
SDK: update the platform to LLVM 20, Qt 6.10.
UI: allow to copy the value of a Value Display easily.
#1720: CMake issues with concurrentqueue on FreeBSD.
#1831: Missing includes.
#1833: Sporadic macOS crash when inferring AI models.
Avnd: processes with file ports will now relativize paths correctly to allow easier project portability across computers.
Avnd: put message bus things in a thread for GUI objects.
CI: a few hundred fixes as always.
Core: use std::span everywhere consistently.
Faust: fix live-coding a synth (#1829).
Fix missing port count in process library.
LV2: fixes to Suil and LV2 integration.
Reworked categories.
SDK: many bugfixes to features to allow building addons against the score SDK.
SDK: rework the CI infrastructure to allow repos building score addons to use a shared set of Github actions on github.com/ossia/actions.
UI: improve multi-xy pad rendering.
UI: improve reliability of script editor GUI.

description.p: ossia score 3.5.3 is another series of small bugfixes and improvements after the large 3.5.0 release.

ul.li: Audio: Support using the PIPEWIRE_QUANTUM in addition to PIPEWIRE_LATENCY to set buffer size and sample rate under pipewire.
Linux: add a small independent binary that will run to devise whether the app has all the necessary dynamic libraries available.
OSC: allow to resolve by using DNS and not just IP addresses; refactor the DNS resolving code across the codebase. (#1689)
Windows: implement camera resolution enumeration using the most atrocious Win32 API.
Image node: add a stretch mode port.
AI models: add EmotionNet support for detecting emotions, DepthAnythingV2 for converting RGB frames into depth frames, and YOLO-segmentation support.
AI models: better default engine selection.
Gestures: add many new gesture detection algorithms courtesy of Yash Tiwary, our GSoC student. Thanks @pyandcpp-coder!
UI: Fix an UI bug when reloading an item with an XY slider.
Core: enforce using the same hash function in most places.
UI: improve rendering performance of cables.
Presets: fix loading presets of objects that may change ports.
Core: large cleanup of codebase compiler warnings which had accumulated.
Packaging: improve support for packaged KFR (#1819).
Core: update to boost 1.88.
Mapper: fix a concurrency bug which could have caused crashes when restoring a score which created and removed mapper devices.
Windows: fix open dialog sometimes having issues (QTBUG-138093).
Windows: fix that KFR was forced to SSE2.
Windows / Mac: fix the Window devices being jittery when moved (#1783).
CSV and audio recorder: ignore quotes in paths as they happen when using the "copy path" feature of Windows 11. (#1598)
Graphics: fix some textures still being inverted on Metal and D3D11/D3D12.
macOS: fix to enable running under Xcode frame capture.
Graphics: allow offscreen renderers to use something else than OpenGL now that it works fine.
